adoption: mean paired gain > participant-cluster bootstrap sample SE

bootstrap.paired_replicates: average matched cell differences across three seed pairs before resampling
bootstrap.weighting: sum sampled cell differences / sampled cell count; not equal subject means

classical_definition.baseline: exact v3 temporal Euclidean log-covariance ridge
classical_definition.checkpoints: fixed deterministic fit; no held-out parameter or checkpoint selection
classical_definition.feature_scaling: training-only weighted global scale, exactly as v3
classical_definition.tangent_mean_weights: equal session; uniform within session; no labels
classical_definition.tangent_origin: affine-invariant geometric mean of training-aligned covariances

cross_subject_mixup.partners: uniformly drawn different-subject examples in fitting minibatch
cross_subject_mixup.rationale: smooth decision boundaries across fitting-subject covariance mixtures

legacy_diagnostic.interpretation: selection-contaminated legacy-split diagnostic; not an independent test estimate or score of the final all10 model

metric: equal mean balanced accuracy over subject/session/interface cells

model.head: z=dropout(BatchNorm(features)); Linear(z,3)+Linear(dropout(GELU(Linear(z,128))),3)
model.initialization: PyTorch defaults; normalized random spatial weights; both head branches initialized normally
model.shared_spatial_weights: one matrix per frequency band, shared across views

nested_classical.features: 14-bank causally Euclidean-aligned log diagonal covariance; training-only weighted coordinate standardization
nested_classical.final_selection: repeat inner LOSO on the authorized final or legacy fitting population only
nested_classical.inner_protocol: LOSO among outer fitting subjects; exclude outer and inner held-out subjects from every fit/reference/scale
nested_classical.neural_branches: exactly shared freshly fitted reconstructed_v6 branches
nested_classical.selection: largest inner equal-cell balanced accuracy; linear before rbf for exact ties

null_result: no candidate final/legacy fit or new submission ZIP; reconstruction is not asserted identical to missing v6
reconstruction_inferences: exact residual-head topology/initialization was lost and is fixed above
v5 optimizer, label smoothing, gains, BN momentum, losses and epoch schedule retained
classical v6 nested recipe was lost; replacement below is newly declared, not recovered
source_freeze: all active implementation files hashed before first fit; bug-only changes recorded and affected work rerun

ssl.description: Fit-only masked log-power reconstruction before baseline fine-tuning
ssl.reconstruction_target: log diagonal covariance, fit-only coordinate standardization
ssl.supervised_restart: same-seed fresh model; replace only pretrained spatial_weight

winner: largest gain minus SE among passes; lexicographic tie break
